summary: No relevant testing skill found. Focused UI/API verification found the Materia filter removed and the new vista export mostly correct, but the /api/exports/grupo/{codigo}/vista endpoint does not enforce decano/coordinador role scope: scoped users with download permission can export an out-of-scope group.

critical.issue: Role scope is not enforced for decano/coordinador. After temporarily enabling download permission for decano.test and coord.test, both could download out-of-scope group PRECBH2602B020258 (Trabajo Social / FCYH) with HTTP 200 instead of 403.

action_items: In exports_router.py, enforce apply_role_scope for /grupo/{codigo_grupo}/vista by validating the requested group's facultad/programa (or the exported students) against the current user's decano/coordinador scope before streaming the file.
Retest out-of-scope vista downloads for decano.test and coord.test after the fix; expected status is 403 while in-scope groups remain 200.
critical_code_review_comments: exports_router.py lines 428-430 computes scope_match = apply_role_scope(user, {}) but never applies it to the grupo lookup or student query; only missing-scope roles are rejected. This leaves out-of-scope group exports accessible to scoped roles when download_enabled is true.
seed_data_creation: No permanent seed data created. The API test temporarily set decano.test@iudigital.edu.co and coord.test@iudigital.edu.co download_enabled=true to isolate scope enforcement, then restored both to their original false values.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Superadmin vista export for PREEAC2602B010224 passed: xlsx has sheets Grupo/Vista docente, exactly 8 columns, 85 data rows + header, and flags match detail-view logic including 'SISBEN A5 | Rural'. Docente demo with download_enabled=false got 403 on own group PREICA2602B020078. UI passed: no Materia filter, DocenteCursosPanel has vista Eye button, Grupos detail modal has Vista actual/Excel completo/CSV. Remaining failure is scoped role access on vista endpoint.
rca_of_the_issue: Reproduction: enable download permission for decano.test or coord.test, login, then GET /api/exports/grupo/PRECBH2602B020258/vista?fmt=xlsx. Expected 403 because the group is outside FCEAC/Administración de Empresas scope; actual 200. Root cause appears to be scope_match calculated but not applied to the group/student export query.
